claims.statement: 运行时 Registry/Graph 描述期望系统，Host Inventory 描述实际可见环境；Reconciliation 将两者对账并把缺失依赖、重复私有所有权、未认领运行时和 PATH 多版本等漂移变成结构化 issue。
浏览器 File、Android content URI、持久授权、本机 font pool 等不是同一种资源身份；跨桥接层时应保留原始原生句柄/URI 或受控副本，而不是从显示名称或 JavaScript 路径重建。

claims.statement: 共享同一 GPU/端口/互斥组的运行时不能只按“谁正在运行”处理；Supervisor 只能自动停止自己拥有的进程，对健康但外部拥有的冲突运行时必须拒绝越权终止并要求显式交接。
多个原生/AI 引擎不共享隐式 shell 环境；每个运行时使用自己的绝对可执行路径、工作目录与受控环境，并通过 registry/supervisor 管理生命周期与互斥资源。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: Web UI 与本机能力桥接时，前端提交受 schema/allowlist 约束的结构化任务，而不是任意 shell/FFmpeg 命令；bridge 只暴露最小能力并保持来源、文件和执行权限边界。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 系统整合不以文件是否共址定义，而以稳定身份、所有权、依赖、生命周期、资源关系、发现与可追溯性定义。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: For ASS-Workbench-Android, component tests on a fast CI path do not prove that the production APK contains the tested native helper; the release path must verify packaging presence and artifact/build identity for that helper.

For HSR-Voice-Archive-Builder outputs that together form one published result, rebuild publication/rollback must preserve the set atomically enough that a failed rebuild does not destroy or mix the previous coherent published set.

For HSR-Voice-Archive-Builder cross-stage media identity, basename alone is not a stable identifier; package-relative/stable member identity must be preserved, and ambiguous fallback must degrade explicitly rather than guess.

For HSR-Voice-Archive-Builder subtitle autosave targeting the same canonical sidecar, persistence writes must have single-writer ordering so a later autosave does not start before the prior write settles.
临时 CI runner 每次生成不同 debug keystore 会让设备把后续测试 APK 视为不同签名应用。快速测试构建应稳定复用 debug signing identity，而生产 release key 必须保持独立私密。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 将 Actions artifacts 视为短期诊断通道而非归档存储；普通 push/PR 不上传，手工诊断才允许短期上传，长期产物进入 Release，并用 policy-as-code 强制执行。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: Intake 自动化应把事实整理成可审查 Proposal：建议记录类型、低成熟度状态、provenance、可能重复项和证据强度；真正落成 typed record 需要显式 accept/reject，且自动路径不得越过 observed/candidate。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 跨仓库 Intake 不应只上传‘CI failed’。源仓库最接近运行现场，应先捕获 workflow/job/step 等低层证据；Foundry 再做确定性分类、关联历史知识和人工复核，从而避免中央系统依赖跨仓库日志权限或凭 workflow 名猜测根因。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 在付费请求发出前估算工作量与成本并执行 token/USD 预算；完成批次和 checkpoint 保持可复用；实际 provider usage 仍是权威事实。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 项目目录是否由应用完整管理决定了克隆/删除能做什么。自动管理根可整体删除；手工工程根只能删除明确拥有的状态/输出/marker，必须保留未知或用户文件。克隆复制可复用生成输入，但不复制旧输出和运行状态。
当发布产物包含受具体 build flags、upstream revision 或许可证组合影响的原生组件时，发布身份必须记录这些构建事实，避免同一版本标签下静默切换能力或许可证语义。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (2/3)

claims.statement: 复杂 UI 请求通常同时包含布局、控制层级、作用域、绑定、发现等多个语义。Foundry 的检索层应返回一组有证据的 Pattern，并用显式 Composition Recipe/Relation 描述它们能否组合、各自角色、实现与证据缺口。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 单独检索 Grammar Pattern 只能回答‘这种界面机制叫什么’；单独检索产品 Surface 只能回答‘哪里已经有这个具体界面’。Foundry 应将两者双向连接，再附上组合 Recipe、真实项目实现、Reference Demo/Visual Baseline 和缺失证据，使自然语言请求直接落到可复用语义与可核验具体实现。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 将 Pattern 的稳定 ID、双语名称、别名、Intent、Use When、Anatomy、Realization 与 Validation 编入机器可读索引；自然语言请求先由确定性词汇/字符相似度解析到候选 Pattern，再由代理根据上下文选择，而不是靠记忆猜测 Pattern 名称。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: Pattern 描述可复用语义，Reference Demo 描述机制，而具体产品如何实现必须单独登记为 Platform Realization。Realization 绑定项目、平台、不可变 commit、源文件 blob、验证文件和限制；报告同时标记该 revision 是否仍等于项目当前 HEAD，避免把历史生产实现静默描述成当前实现。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (0/1)

claims.statement: 可运行 Reference Demo 能证明机制和交互契约，但不能冒充生产 UI 或视觉基线；生产截图/录屏证明某次真实实现，Golden Baseline 才承担受控状态下的视觉回归参照。Foundry 应显式标注这三种证据层级。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 数百个具体界面、工具、面板、对话框和工作区不应被强行提升为数百条 Grammar Pattern。产品仓库通过 .uigs/ui-surfaces.json 持有具体 UI 清单；Foundry 按稳定 Surface ID 收集实现位置、实际效果、Pattern 关系、测试和视觉证据，形成派生索引。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (0/2)

claims.statement: Prevention generation 2 for destructive optional-input tri-state handling enforces validation-gated construction and regression coverage for the documented Search/Replace recurrence within the listed ASS Workbench Android scope.
Prevention generation 1 for infinite-canvas unbounded measurement has a submitted Android regression control, but current evidence does not yet establish enforced-main/runtime coverage.
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (0/1)

claims.statement: Prevention generation 1 for primary inspector action reachability has executable controls covering the documented failure mechanism within the listed ASS Workbench Android scope.
Prevention generation 1 for structural semantic-cleanup ownership has executable parser and regression controls covering the documented nested ASS semantics within the listed scope.
Prevention generation 1 for visible-text replacement token boundaries has enforced semantic-token and regression controls covering the documented ASS control-escape failure within the listed scope.
将底层日志与异常模式归入稳定错误类别，并为每类错误提供原因、恢复动作与成品是否仍可保存等语义，而不是直接把原始错误文本当产品反馈。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 硬件编码器、字幕渲染、Native bridge 等能力不能因为 API 名称存在、encoder 被枚举或 FFmpeg 返回成功就视为可用；需要产生并验证真正体现目标能力的输出。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (2/3)

claims.statement: 昂贵工作检查点只有在 provider/base URL/model/源语言/目标语言等执行路线一致，且单条输入指纹仍匹配时才能安全复用；路线变化或输入变化应失效而不是猜测兼容。
存在 paths/path-filter 的仓库中，某工作流最新一次成功运行可能针对旧 commit。跨项目报告必须显示 run head SHA 是否等于当前主分支 HEAD，不能把‘latest success’静默表述成‘当前代码已验证’。
多分钟或多小时的正式任务应把中间/待发布成品放在受控、可恢复的持久 job 目录；启动前检查空间，完成后验证并交付，所有 terminal path 显式清理或保留为可恢复状态。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 异步计算、渲染、扫描或保存必须携带可验证的 generation/session/epoch 身份；旧任务完成后不得覆盖更新的状态或文件。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 自动恢复不能只写一个 latest 文件；应校验格式、大小、checksum 和语义身份，保留上一代已知良好副本，并在落盘后重新读取验证精确字节。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 会原地替换多份已发布产物的重建流程，应在进入构建前保存最后一套一致发布状态；普通失败时整体回滚，而不是让用户看到新旧文件混杂的半成品。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 移动设备长时间高负载时吞吐可能显著变化，因此 ETA 应基于滚动实测吞吐而不是初始 FPS 线性外推；热状态是解释性能变化的运行证据，不应被误报为编码器故障。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 不可变 revision 证明历史证据；当前仍适用与否应额外比较声明的实现源文件在当前 HEAD 的 Git blob identity。文档、CI 或 .uigs 元数据等无关提交使 revision != HEAD 时，不应自动把未变化的实现标成 stale。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (3/4)

claims.statement: 不能只验证某个组件在快速 CI 中可用；正式发布流水线必须实际打包并验证同一被测试实现，否则会产生“测试绿、成品缺组件”的发布路径不对称。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 耗时编码、构建或原生任务应由持久生命周期组件单独拥有；第二个正式任务必须拒绝或排队，所有终止路径都要由同一 owner 清理会话、临时资源和可观察状态。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (2/3)

claims.statement: 远程/外部更新不应把“新增、已有、已有但变化、变量、冲突”压成一个下载列表。先形成可审计计划；有冲突或已有对象变化时保留双方证据并转人工审查，自动动作只处理可靠识别的增量。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 长任务或媒体输出先写入受控 staging/temporary 位置，经真实解析与完整性检查后再复制/发布到用户目标；FFmpeg return code 或 progress=100% 不是持久成功的充分条件。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 包含 arm64 原生库的 APK 在发布路径中检查 16 KiB ZIP alignment 和 ELF LOAD segment alignment；不能因为上游构建宣称使用相应 flags 就省略对最终 APK 的验证。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 安全扫描器必须能识别超大/极端输入，同时自身也必须有字符、token、数字项等工作预算，避免防御逻辑复制被防御的无界工作模式。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 容器处理 E2E 不只验证文件存在，而用独立 probe 检查 stream codec/order、language/title、Default/Forced、attachments、chapters、format metadata 与预期审计模型一致。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 测试不只覆盖单功能 happy path，而以‘领域 + 破坏性组合 + 必须保持的不变量 + 证据层级’组织，从 Raw preservation、编码、撤销、生命周期、容器、异步保存、发布路径等维度主动攻击。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 对用户文件格式的编码兼容不能停留在 parser 单测；生成真实 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE 等夹具，并让浏览器/产品路径实际导入、处理和输出。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 任务系统必须证明失败和取消不是终局污染：旧下载、旧 metadata、disabled state、临时 runtime 状态都应清理，紧接着的新任务能成功且不继承旧任务语义。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 当渲染链可能在返回成功的同时静默缺失目标效果时，使用有/无该效果的受控输出进行像素/区域差分，证明效果真的进入最终渲染结果。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 对真实 Android APP 的可重复视觉证据，使用 source-owned deterministic fixture 驱动真实生产 Compose 树，在 emulator 中显式安装 app/test APK、运行 instrumentation、由 UiAutomation 捕获最终 display/compositor，再进行 PNG/方向/hash/provenance 校验并注册到 Surface ID。

For UIGS Android visual capture, successful connected/instrumentation test completion does not prove that a later app-private artifact is still a valid PNG; screenshot creation, extraction, and binary validation must be an explicit capture lifecycle.

For UIGS Android visual capture, declared device/viewport orientation is not evidence of final output orientation; the final PNG must be checked against the capture contract before evidence registration.

For multi-state UIGS Android evidence capture, already validated early immutable evidence should be persisted by stage before later high-risk states; a late-stage failure must still fail final validation but must not discard earlier valid evidence.
In Foundry shell batch loops driven by while-read input, child tools that may consume stdin (such as adb) must receive isolated stdin so they cannot silently consume the loop protocol.
For third-party GitHub Actions that execute a script field, the nested shell is part of the action interface contract; Foundry must not use Bash-only semantics unless Bash is invoked explicitly.
视觉结果是主任务时，将大预览保持为主表面，把参数、诊断和次级控制压缩到右侧检查器，并在窄屏降级为单列。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: A deterministic derived artifact must be produced by its authoritative generator even for an empty-data bootstrap state; a hand-written object that is semantically similar but has a different deterministic shape must not be treated as equivalent generated state.
Governance maturity is not irreversible truth: new defeating evidence may remove a Claim's effective default authority without erasing its historical promotion state.

Evidence derived from the same upstream decision, rule, experiment, or implementation must not be counted as independent confirmation merely because it appears in multiple downstream artifacts or repositories.

A GitHub Actions workflow that writes a commit with the repository GITHUB_TOKEN must not assume that commit's ordinary push event will trigger a dependent workflow; required deterministic downstream transformations must run in the same workflow transaction or use an explicit supported dispatch mechanism.

Multiple GitHub Actions writers updating the same branch must treat remote-ref movement as optimistic concurrency: bounded fetch/rebase/push retry is appropriate for replayable non-overlapping writes, while semantic/rebase conflicts must fail explicitly and derived artifacts should be regenerated from current source state rather than conflict-merged.
在参数密集的 Inspector 中保持主要动作和高频基础参数可见，将低频高级参数按语义组折叠/分区，避免一条无限增长的同级参数墙。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 在视觉预览上提供对象发现、定位和直接操作入口，同时明确该覆盖层只是交互/发现层，不冒充最终渲染器或字形命中权威。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 使用一份机器可读工具元数据作为固定布局、自由 Canvas、搜索和导航的共同目录；目录是检索入口，不复制业务能力。

For UIGS composition planning, a multi-intent UI request must not be reduced to one global ranking outcome; explicit intent segmentation and merged orthogonal Pattern retrieval are required to preserve independently expressed UI intents.

When a regular expression crosses programming-language string and JSON serialization boundaries in Foundry schemas, validation must check the parsed regex semantics rather than infer correctness from source-level backslash counts.
A Foundry CI commit guard that decides whether generated outputs changed must account for untracked files; git diff alone is insufficient for first-generation outputs.

Cross-project UIGS web capture orchestration must not infer that a Node project has a lockfile or supports npm ci/cache solely from its package manager; install/cache strategy must come from an explicit source contract or observed repository files.
让同一种工具可以存在多个实例，每个实例明确绑定到自己的领域对象，而不是通过修改全局 Focus 间接决定写入目标。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 在专业编辑器中，让用户在执行修改前能看见当前写入对象、写入层级以及可能影响的对象数量，而不把这层解释 UI 变成新的状态所有者。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 在主工作区继续滚动时，让次要但持续相关的状态、检查或操作保持可见。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)

claims.statement: 将拖动/缩放过程中的临时几何与已提交、可恢复的工作区布局分离，避免旋转、窄视口、手势取消或临时 clamp 污染用户的长期布局。
reasons: qualifying independent support below policy minimum (1/2)
